title: Ambiguous Feature Scope
description: The project requirements lack clarity around dashboard filtering logic, increasing the likelihood of misaligned development and rework.

title: Inconsistent Data Model Across Teams
description: Different engineering teams use slightly different interpretations of key fields, increasing the likelihood of reporting discrepancies.

title: API Throughput Constraints
description: Backend APIs may not handle anticipated peak traffic, leading to slow response times or timeouts.

title: Lack of Automated Regression Testing
description: New releases risk introducing unintended side effects due to limited automated test coverage.

title: Late Stakeholder Feedback Cycles
description: Stakeholders review deliverables too late in the process, increasing the likelihood of last-minute redesigns and extended timelines.

title: Vendor Library Deprecation
description: A third-party dependency used in the project is scheduled for deprecation, posing maintenance and compatibility issues.

title: Insufficient UX Validation
description: User experience patterns have not been validated with representative users, increasing the risk of low adoption and usability issues.

title: Performance Bottlenecks in Dashboard Rendering
description: Data-heavy components may degrade responsiveness, negatively impacting user experience and increasing abandonment.

title: PDF Export Branding Failures
description: Brand guidelines are inconsistently applied in exported PDFs, reducing perceived professionalism.

title: Limited Backend Engineering Capacity
description: Engineering staffing constraints may slow delivery and increase the risk of unmet deadlines.
